decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already captures the required output change from a generic flipbook deliverable to delivery of the final PDF. The Heyzine white-label configuration requires no additional output-state change.
Selecting Heyzine with white-label access does not alter the requirement that the layout remain balanced and compatible with two-page spreads.

The platform and branding configuration does not change the article-end whitespace rules. The source message's separate instruction to use images without extra text is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
Heyzine white-label access concerns platform branding and does not change the magazine layout's existing polished, modern, URL_001-aligned visual style.
The flipbook platform and white-label decision does not alter author names, photographs, sizing, sourcing, or placement.
The word label in white label is incidental overlap; the platform decision does not change article category labels or their presentation.
The Heyzine configuration does not affect future article word-count guidance for avoiding layout whitespace.
Obtaining Heyzine white-label access does not change the required sharpness or clarity of advertisement assets.
The flipbook platform configuration does not alter the approved Inter typeface, weight, or readability constraint.
The selected platform and branding mode do not change the requirement for accurate cover article page numbers.
The Heyzine white-label decision does not alter table-of-contents timing or page-number accuracy.
The platform and branding configuration does not change the requirement to remediate low-quality article images when necessary.
